system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: sys_msg = {"role": "system", "content": self.wiki} if not self.use_hirarchy_prompt else {"role": "system", "content":  hirarchy_prompt['additional_prompt'] + hirarchy_prompt['start_of_policy'] + self.wiki + hirarchy_prompt['end_of_policy']}
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt is the domain policy wiki, optionally wrapped in hierarchy template.

env_context_strategy.note: No repository/environment; task is a conversational customer-service env with API tools only.

context_compaction.note: Full message list is resent each step; no truncation or summarization code.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
res = completion(
                messages=injected_messages,
                model=self.model,
                custom_llm_provider=self.provider,
                tools=self.tools_info,
tool_call_format.note: Default --agent-strategy tool-calling uses native tools; chat_react_agent parses 'Action: {json}'; rits_agent parses <START_TOOL_CALL> tags.

tool_count.note: Airline domain (README default --env airline) ships 14 tool files under envs/airline/tools; retail ships 17.

edit_primitive.note: Tools are domain API functions (reservations, orders); no file-editing tool exists.

tool_schema_source.note: Each tool class returns a hand-written schema dict from get_info().

protocol_standardization.note: Proprietary Tool ABC; no MCP/A2A code in file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: instruction = REACT_INSTRUCTION if use_reasoning else ACT_INSTRUCTION
loop_primitives.note: Target agent loops over max_num_steps calling model then env.step; CRAFT attacker side adds planning agents.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
Thought:
<A single line of reasoning to process the context and inform the decision making. Do not include extra lines.>
planning_granularity.note: Attacker side has cached plans from DeceptionPlanner, but no stored plan object for the agent.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: CRAFT is a policy-aware red-teaming multi-agent system, designed to expose vulnerabilities in policy-constrained LLM-based agents through strategic, multi-step adversarial planning.
multi_agent_topology.note: PolicyAnalyzer -> DeceptionPlanner/AvoidanceAdvisor -> DialogueExecutor is a fixed hand-off sequence of specialised agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Finally, the DialogueExecutor is responsible for executing the interaction with the target agent. It receives explicit instructions from the planning agents and executes the dialogue

human_in_loop.note: Actions executed directly; --user-strategy can be human but that replaces the user simulator, not a gate.

long_term_memory.note: Cached PolicyAnalyzer/strategy JSONs are precomputed attack artefacts, not cross-run agent memory.

state_persistence.note: Every task run starts from env.reset; no resume path.

self_verification.note: Also deterministic_checker.py; used for outcome evaluation rather than agent self-review.

retry_policy.note: n=4 independent trials are for pass@k measurement, not retry-on-failure.

rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism in the env step loop.

termination_condition.note: max_num_steps: int = 30 caps turns; done flag ends the episode.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: caching intermediate artefacts (e.g., Pol- icyAnalyzer outputs) to prevent redundant model inferences
cost_controls.note: Cached attack strategies under tau_bench/attacks_cache; also model_utils/api/cache.py.

timeouts.note: No timeout parameters visible in agent loop or tool invocation.

execution_isolation.note: Tools are Python functions executed in-process against JSON data files.

filesystem_access.note: Agent acts on an in-memory simulated database, not a real filesystem.

network_policy.note: Tools operate only on local JSON data; no network egress for agent actions (LLM API calls excluded).

permission_model.note: Every emitted tool call is executed; policy adherence is prompt-level only.

tracing.note: Messages are logged; SolveResult carries messages and info for result files.

replayability.evidence_quote: with seed set to 10 for re- producibility
replayability.note: Seeded reruns; no trajectory replay code found.

eval_hooks.note: Repo ships run.py, evaluate_attack.py and display_results.py for the tau-break benchmark.

guardrails.evidence_quote: "content": "Reminder: The following policy must be strictly followed:\n" + self.wiki
guardrails.note: Defenses are prompt-level (hierarchical prompt, policy reminders) injected into the input; no action blocking.

target_domain.evidence_quote: CRAFT, a targeted attack method that leverages policy knowledge and multi-agent strategic planning to induce policy violations in state-of-the-art agents
target_domain.note: Domain is customer-service tool-using agents plus red-teaming/safety evaluation.

open_source.note: Public repo; no LICENSE file visible in the file tree.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This code is based on the paper ["Effective Red-Teaming of Policy-Adherent Agents"](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09600).

first_release_date.note: No tags; basis is arXiv v1 date implied by id 2506.09600.
